reviews_verbatim.author: Diana A.
reviews_verbatim.text: I've been at this spot three times already and every time I love it even more! I've tried their guac, chicken quesadilla, carne asada burrito, al pastor tacos, chicken tacos, everything is amazing.

reviews_verbatim.author: Nathalie R.
reviews_verbatim.text: The food portions are big. The al pastor tacos and horchata is so good. The food doesn't take long to make and service is great!

reviews_verbatim.author: Daph R.
reviews_verbatim.text: 10/10 service super fast tacos r a great size and it comes with chips and salsa. flan is also so good would recommend!!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Johanna D.
reviews_verbatim.text: This truck is amazing! The food is amazing. The portions are huge.

reviews_verbatim.author: Jennifer L.
reviews_verbatim.text: They are beyond nice, good prices for the portion, a taste of delicious authentic Mexican food.
